text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Tuesday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Prosecutor General Vladas Nikitinas resigned over the rise in crime.
- Latvian Prime Minister Andris Shkele announced he was to resign.
- Nikitinas said that some of the criticisms levelled against his office by President Algirdas Brazauskas and other politicians were correct.
- Lithuanian Airlines is to lease two SAAB 340s from Sweden's SAAB company.
- The government said it has declared war on crime.
- The merger of four state-owned oil companies into one large concern, approved by the previous government last year, will be carried out soon.
- Changes to alchohlo and tobacco control laws will be made that will allow drinks that figure in a top 100 of alcholholic beverages can be imported into Lithuania.
